    def handle_update_conversational_flow(self, first_response, prompt_used, original_value, index, max_turns=3, user_type: Optional[str] = None):
        """
        Handle multi-turn conversation for update operations with metadata-aware validation and restore.
    
        Iterates through conversation turns, checking metadata type at each step:
        - type == "success": Validates metadata, restores to original value, verifies update, and evaluates
        - type == "error": Fails immediately
        - Otherwise: Continues to next turn up to max_turns
    
        If max_turns is exhausted without success/error, evaluates full conversation
        with conversational-professionalism metric.
    
        Args:
            first_response: Initial LLM response
            prompt_used: Original user prompt (update command)
            original_value: Original DB value before update (for restore)
            index: Index for attachment naming
            max_turns: Maximum conversation turns to attempt (default: 3)
            user_type: Optional user type to use for client.ask (e.g., "Admin")
        """
        turns = [
            {"role": "user", "content": prompt_used},
            {"role": "assistant", "content": first_response}
        ]
    
        current_prompt, current_response = prompt_used, first_response
    
        for turn in range(1, max_turns):
            reply = self.generate.reply_for_llm(
                current_response, self.section_name, self.entry_name, current_prompt, turns=turns, section_desc=self.section_desc, item_desc=self.item_desc
            )
            # Add user reply to turns as soon as it is generated
            turns.append({"role": "user", "content": reply})
            ask_result = self.client.ask(session_id=self.session_id, user_query=reply, user_type=user_type)
            next_response = ask_result["text_response"]
            next_metadata = ask_result.get("metadata")
            next_type = next_metadata.get("type") if next_metadata else None
            # Add assistant response to turns as soon as it is captured
            turns.append({"role": "assistant", "content": next_response})
    
            # Attach full turns before any validation/branching
            allure.attach(str(turns), name=f"Turns [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
    
            # Check metadata type for early exit/specialized handling
            if next_type == "success" or next_type == "info":
                # Validate metadata and restore DB on success
                allure.attach(
                    str(next_metadata),
                    name=f"Turn {turn+1} Metadata [{index}]",
                    attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT
                )
                allure.attach(
                    str(next_response),
                    name=f"Turn {turn+1} Response [{index}]",
                    attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT
                )
    
    
                # Validate and restore metadata
                self.validate_metadata_and_restore_db(next_metadata, user_type=user_type)
    
                # Get updated value and verify
                updated_value = self.client.get_config_entry_with_mapped_section(
                    self.section_name, self.entry_name, generate_llm=self.generate
                )
                allure.attach(str(updated_value), name=f"Updated Config Value [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
    
                # Restore to original value
                restore_success = self.client.update_config_entry_value(original_value, user_type=user_type)
                allure.attach(str(restore_success), name=f"Restored DB to original [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
    
                # Verify update matches intent

                    f"DB value does not match intended value after update.\nPrompt: {prompt_used}\nDB Value: {updated_value}"
                )
